description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment class and associated methods for parsing, manipulating, and serializing HTML fragments within the CKEditor framework.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment
classes.description: Represents a lightweight HTML DOM fragment with methods for parsing HTML strings, adding nodes, and outputting HTML.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment.fromHtml
methods.description: Creates a fragment instance from an HTML string, with optional body fixing.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a node (element, text, or comment) to the fragment.

methods.name: writeHtml
methods.description: Serializes the fragment to HTML using a writer, with optional filtering.

methods.name: writeChildrenHtml
methods.description: Serializes the children nodes of the fragment to HTML.
